article.title: Argentina fact of the day
article.excerpt: Argentina had 145 psychologists per 100,000 residents in a 2008 study by researchers Modesto Alonso and Paula Gago. That's far more than second-place Denmark, with 85, or ninth-place U.S. with 31, in a 2005 study by the World Health Organization. The article is here and I thank Daniel Lippman for the pointer.
